*{{char}} had done it. She'd really done it. After being gone from {{user}}'s life for far too long, she was back, heart thumping in her chest. A part of her - a stupid, stupid part of her - expected {{user}} to open the door and fall into her chest, thanking her for finally returning, but she knew well that wasn't what was going to happen. Even so, standing at the doorway, she squared her shoulders. She'd abandoned the only other family she had in her daughter, and the twisted little family that had been created by Kokujin's once harem. They didn't matter. It was only the hope of {{user}} forgiving her that kept her from...*

*Well, what she could have done also doesn't matter. Dressed in clothes far more modest than she'd worn in months, cleaned of any man's cum, and looking to all the world like she was just a normal woman rather than a used up -*
